001package zemeckis;
002
003import grim.annotations.OmitSymbol;
004import org.jetbrains.annotations.TestOnly;
005import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
006
007/**
008 * Utility class for interacting with Zemeckis config settings in tests.
009 */
010@SuppressWarnings("Varifier")
011@TestOnly
012public final class ZemeckisTestUtil {
013    private ZemeckisTestUtil() {}
014
015    /**
016     * Interface to intercept log messages emitted by runtime.
017     */
018    public interface Logger {
019        /**
020         * Log message and exception.
021         *
022         * @param message the message.
023         * @param throwable the exception or null.
024         */
025        void log(String message, @Nullable Throwable throwable);
026    }
027
028    /**
029     * Reset the state of zemeckis config to either production or development state.
030     *
031     * @param productionMode true to set it to production mode configuration, false to set it to development mode config.
032     */
033    @SuppressWarnings("ConstantConditions")
034    public static void resetConfig(final boolean productionMode) {
035        if (ZemeckisConfig.isProductionMode()) {
036            /*
037             * This should really never happen but if it does add assertion (so code stops in debugger) or
038             * failing that throw an exception.
039             */
040            assert !ZemeckisConfig.isProductionMode();
041            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to reset config as Zemeckis is in production mode");
042        }
043
044        if (productionMode) {
045            disableNames();
046            disableUncaughtErrorHandlers();
047        } else {
048            enableNames();
049            enableUncaughtErrorHandlers();
050        }
051        purgeTasksWhenRunawayDetected();
052        resetState();
053    }
054
055    /**
056     * Reset the state of Zemeckis.
057     * This occasionally needs to be invoked after changing configuration settings in tests.
058     */
059    private static void resetState() {
060        TemporalScheduler.reset();
061        setLogger(null);
062        Zemeckis.reset();
063        UncaughtErrorHandlerSupport.reset();
064        VirtualProcessorUnitsHolder.reset();
065    }
066
067    /**
068     * Specify logger to use to capture logging in tests
069     *
070     * @param logger the logger.
071     */
072    public static void setLogger(@Nullable final Logger logger) {
073        /*
074         * This should really never happen but if it does add assertion (so code stops in debugger).
075         */
076        assert !ZemeckisConfig.isProductionMode();
077        if (ZemeckisConfig.isDevelopmentMode()) {
078            final ZemeckisLogger.ProxyLogger proxyLogger = (ZemeckisLogger.ProxyLogger) ZemeckisLogger.getLogger();
079            proxyLogger.setLogger(null == logger ? null : logger::log);
080        }
081    }
082
083    /**
084     * Set `zemeckis.enable_names` setting to true.
085     */
086    public static void enableNames() {
087        ZemeckisConfig.setEnableNames(true);
088    }
089
090    /**
091     * Set `zemeckis.enable_names` setting to false.
092     */
093    public static void disableNames() {
094        ZemeckisConfig.setEnableNames(false);
095    }
096
097    /**
098     * Set `zemeckis.purge_tasks_when_runaway_detected` setting to true.
099     */
100    public static void purgeTasksWhenRunawayDetected() {
101        ZemeckisConfig.setPurgeOnRunaway(true);
102    }
103
104    /**
105     * Set `zemeckis.purge_tasks_when_runaway_detected` setting to false.
106     */
107    public static void noPurgeTasksWhenRunawayDetected() {
108        ZemeckisConfig.setPurgeOnRunaway(false);
109    }
110
111    /**
112     * Set `zemeckis.enable_uncaught_error_handlers` setting to true.
113     */
114    public static void enableUncaughtErrorHandlers() {
115        ZemeckisConfig.setEnableUncaughtErrorHandlers(true);
116    }
117
118    /**
119     * Set `zemeckis.enable_uncaught_error_handlers` setting to false.
120     */
121    public static void disableUncaughtErrorHandlers() {
122        ZemeckisConfig.setEnableUncaughtErrorHandlers(false);
123    }
124
125    /**
126     * Execute the next task scheduled by the deterministic test scheduler, advancing its clock to the task's due time.
127     *
128     * @return true if a task was executed, false if no task was scheduled.
129     * @throws IllegalStateException if the deterministic test scheduler is not enabled.
130     */
131    @OmitSymbol(unless = "zemeckis.use_test_scheduler")
132    public static boolean pumpNext() {
133        return TemporalScheduler.pumpNext();
134    }
135
136    /**
137     * Execute scheduled JVM tasks until no tasks remain.
138     *
139     * @return the number of tasks executed.
140     * @throws IllegalStateException if the deterministic test scheduler is not enabled or does not become empty after
141     *     executing 10,000 tasks.
142     */
143    @OmitSymbol(unless = "zemeckis.use_test_scheduler")
144    public static int pumpAll() {
145        return TemporalScheduler.pumpAll();
146    }
147}
